section: Growth of nationalist poetry in Telugu - Gurajada, Rayaprolu, Garimella Satyanarayana
subsections: Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham - patriotic verse, occasion, consequence

accepted.s: In which context did Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham improvise the patriotic verse beginning with “Bharata khandambu...” ?
o: During the 1907 speeches of Bipin Chandra Pal at Rajahmundry
During the Home Rule meetings led by Annie Besant
During the visit of the Simon Commission
accepted.x: Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham translated Bipin Chandra Pal’s 1907 speeches and improvised the verse at Rajahmundry.
accepted.tq: Link the poet, occasion, place and year in a single factual recall question.
accepted.sec: Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham - patriotic verse, occasion, consequence

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the literary contribution of Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham at Rajahmundry?
o: He composed Maakoddee Tella Doratanamu and was jailed in 1922
He translated Bipin Chandra Pal’s speeches and improvised a patriotic verse
He edited Golconda Patrika and wrote Gabbilam
He founded Bhavakavitvam and wrote Ekanta Seva
accepted.x: At Rajahmundry, Chilakamarti translated Bipin Chandra Pal’s speeches and improvised the patriotic verse “Bharata khandambu...”.
accepted.tq: Use the author–work–event association and reject swapped-author distractors.
accepted.sec: Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham - patriotic verse, occasion, consequence

accepted.s: The later patriotic verse “Bharata khandambe okka pedda bandikhana” expressed India as which of the following?
o: A large prison under colonial rule
A prosperous kingdom protected by the British
A sacred land beyond foreign influence
accepted.x: The verse literally presents the Indian subcontinent as one large prison, conveying the reality of British colonial rule.
accepted.tq: Test the exact meaning of a quoted line rather than its author.
accepted.sec: Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham - patriotic verse, occasion, consequence

accepted.s: Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham is recognised as the first Telugu national poet. Which work is associated with the distinction of being the first Telugu national song?
accepted.x: “Hinduvulara ennaallee gati” is recognised as the first Telugu national song, while Chilakamarti is recognised as the first Telugu national poet.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the poet’s title from the separately identified first national song.
accepted.sec: Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham - patriotic verse, occasion, consequence

accepted.s: Which periodical was edited by Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham?
accepted.x: Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham edited Desamata.
accepted.tq: Apply the editor–periodical association and avoid confusing it with another Telugu publication.
accepted.sec: Chilakamarti Lakshmi Narasimham - patriotic verse, occasion, consequence

accepted.s: Who is regarded as the founder of Bhavakavitvam?
accepted.x: Rayaprolu Subbarao is regarded as the founder of Bhavakavitvam.
accepted.tq: Use direct founder recall with closely related poets as distractors.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Bhavakavitvam:
1. It emphasised romantic and personal emotion.
2. It included nature and love as important themes.
3. It sought freedom from classical prosody.
4. It had no patriotic strands.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Bhavakavitvam emphasised romantic and personal emotion, nature, love and freedom from classical prosody, and it also contained patriotic strands. Therefore, statement 4 is false.
accepted.tq: Find the one negating statement that reverses a feature of the movement.

accepted.s: Which of the following groups consists entirely of poets identified as major poets of Bhavakavitvam?
o: Basavaraju Apparao, Duvvuri Ramireddy, Devulapalli Krishna Sastri
Gurajada Apparao, Garimella Satyanarayana, Sri Sri
Bipin Chandra Pal, Rayaprolu Subbarao, Damaraju Pundarikakshudu
Kopparapu Subbarao, Krovvidi Lingaraju, Madduri Annapurnaiah
accepted.x: Basavaraju Apparao, Duvvuri Ramireddy and Devulapalli Krishna Sastri are listed among the main poets of Bhavakavitvam.
accepted.tq: Identify the complete group by separating movement poets from associated nationalist figures and prose contributors.

accepted.s: The Venkata Parvateeswara Kavulu are associated with which work, described as the “Telugu Gitanjali”?
accepted.x: Ekanta Seva, associated with the Venkata Parvateeswara Kavulu, is described as the “Telugu Gitanjali”.
accepted.tq: Match the literary group with its distinctive work and description.

accepted.s: Which of the following was the first Telugu play banned by the British?
accepted.x: Roshanara, authored by Kopparapu Subbarao, was the first Telugu play banned by the British.
accepted.tq: Use the superlative clue “first” and distinguish the action from later arrests and prosecutions.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly states the year and consequence associated with Maakoddee Tella Doratanamu?
o: 1931; its author was jailed for sedition under Section 124A
No year given; its performers were arrested in Vizag
accepted.x: Maakoddee Tella Doratanamu is associated with 1922, and its author Garimella was jailed.
accepted.tq: Separate closely related years and consequences in a proscribed-literature table.

accepted.s: Chicharapidugu was serialised during which period in Congress, and what consequence followed for its editor?
o: 1907–08; the work was banned as the first Telugu play
accepted.x: Chicharapidugu was serialised in Congress from 1927 to 1929, and its editor Madduri Annapurnaiah was jailed.
accepted.tq: Pair the publication period with the correct person and consequence.

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched?
o: Veerabali — Krovvidi Lingaraju — 1931 — jailed for sedition under Section 124A
Veerabali — Kopparapu Subbarao — first play banned by the British
accepted.x: Veerabali was written by Krovvidi Lingaraju in 1931, and he was jailed for sedition under Section 124A.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure author–work pair and verify the year and official consequence.

accepted.s: The work Tirugubatu was banned on the charge of:
accepted.x: Tirugubatu by Muni Manikyam Narasimha Rao was banned for “inciting the people”.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the stated ground for prohibition from the separate ground of sedition.

accepted.s: Who wrote Tirugubatu?
accepted.x: Tirugubatu was authored by Muni Manikyam Narasimha Rao.
accepted.tq: Apply the author–title association without confusing it with neighbouring proscribed works.

accepted.s: What was the immediate consequence associated with performances of Panchala Parabhavam?
o: The author was jailed for sedition under Section 124A
The work was banned for inciting the people
The editor of Congress was jailed
accepted.x: Performers of Panchala Parabhavam by Damaraju Pundarikakshudu were arrested in Vizag.
accepted.tq: Focus on the action taken against performers rather than the author or editor.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following works in chronological order according to the years specifically associated with them:
A. Maakoddee Tella Doratanamu
B. Chicharapidugu
C. Veerabali
D. Roshanara
accepted.x: Roshanara was the earliest item identified as the first banned play, followed by Maakoddee Tella Doratanamu in 1922, Chicharapidugu in 1927–29 and Veerabali in 1931.
accepted.tq: Fix the known first item, then arrange the dated works from 1922 through 1931.

accepted.s: Why did nationalist songs in spoken Telugu have a wider social reach than pamphlets?
o: They were written exclusively in classical prosody
They avoided political and social themes
They were restricted to educated urban readers
They could reach villagers who could not be reached effectively by pamphlets
accepted.x: Songs in spoken Telugu could reach villagers more effectively than pamphlets, thereby widening nationalist communication.
accepted.tq: Apply the communication advantage of spoken-language literature to a social situation.

accepted.s: Which literary development is associated with Gurajada in the growth of Telugu nationalist and progressive writing?
o: Banning all patriotic songs from public performance
Making vyavaharika bhasha a normal literary medium
Restoring exclusive dependence on classical prosody
Limiting Telugu literature to court poetry
accepted.x: Gurajada helped make vyavaharika bhasha, or spoken Telugu, a normal literary medium.
accepted.tq: Identify the specific linguistic contribution rather than a broad political claim.

accepted.s: The progressive writers later widened the social critique of Telugu literature primarily towards which issues?
accepted.x: Progressive writers extended the critique of society to caste and class issues.
accepted.tq: Select the paired social categories that define the later expansion of literary criticism.

accepted.s: At the World Telugu Mahasabhalu, which of the following set of Jnanpith awardees was recalled along with Gurajada and Sri Sri by Chief Minister Naidu?
o: Viswanatha, C. Narayana Reddy and Ravuri Bharadwaja
Rayaprolu Subbarao, Garimella Satyanarayana and Duvvuri Ramireddy
Kopparapu Subbarao, Krovvidi Lingaraju and Muni Manikyam Narasimha Rao
Basavaraju Apparao, Devulapalli Krishna Sastri and Madduri Annapurnaiah
accepted.x: Chief Minister Naidu recalled Gurajada, Sri Sri and the Jnanpith winners Viswanatha, C. Narayana Reddy and Ravuri Bharadwaja at the World Telugu Mahasabhalu.
accepted.tq: Test the complete membership of a named group rather than one isolated name.

accepted.s: The Bhava Kavitvam–Abhyudaya debate chiefly concerns whether romanticism was escapist or whether it:
o: Served as a necessary liberation of literary form
Eliminated all patriotic elements from poetry
Required a return to court literature
Made spoken Telugu unsuitable for public communication
accepted.x: The debate contrasts the criticism of romanticism as escapist with the view that it was a necessary liberation of literary form.
accepted.tq: Identify both sides of a literary debate and choose the precise contrasting proposition.
